parlay.note: Combine the two least-correlated graded rules. Legs are only worth combining if their outcomes are genuinely independent; the measured correlation decides that, not intuition.

best_pair.caveat: Win probabilities are measured against MY line, not against a book price, so this is a correlation exercise, not a payout.
